concepts.name: 流量透镜
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: standalone desktop application icon concept for Bandix, a network traffic monitoring, bandwidth control and device usage tool.
Exactly ONE icon on a square canvas. Bold minimal standalone SYMBOL. Absolutely no letters, no B monogram, no typography. Premium flat vector-like geometry with only very subtle tonal depth, crisp solid forms, broad strokes, spacious negative space, readable at 24–32 pixels. One opaque rounded-square tile occupies 86% of the canvas, clean smooth rounded corners, transparent empty outer margin. Symbol stays within the tile with generous internal padding. Clean alpha edges.
Avoid: screenshots, mockups, sheets, multiple icons, labels, watermarks, tiny circuitry, hairline details, external shadows, glows, excessive gradients, 3D ribbon rendering, decorative particles, pixels outside tile.
Subject: a single thick circular inspection lens, whose short diagonal handle is seamlessly integrated into the lower-right of its ring. Inside the large open lens, a bold cyan flowing bandwidth wave with one clean crest and one trough, and a short orange secondary wave below it. The wave is network traffic monitoring, not a medical ECG. Compact coherent symbol, beautifully balanced, no extra marks. Deep slate-navy tile, pale ice-blue lens ring, cyan and orange waveform. More branded and abstract than a generic search icon.

concepts.edit_prompt: Edit the attached network radar app icon. Remove the dark irregular blotch/stain in the lower-right of the dark teal rounded-square tile, restoring that region to the same smooth uniform dark teal background as its neighbors. Keep the radar symbol, cyan arc, two white square nodes, mint sweep wedge, tile shape, framing and all other design unchanged. Clean pristine flat app icon. Preserve the genuinely transparent margin outside the tile. No added marks.
